articles.title: If Jensen Huang is done at Nvidia, who will be the next CEO? Johny Srouji?
articles.summary:
With reports that the company’s board is meeting to oust Huang from the company he co-founded, Bloomberg reports the board has been working with an unnamed outside firm to identify candidates and is considering naming a temporary chief executive while continuing to look for a permanent replacement.
According to Semafor, the list includes Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji, who was reportedly “seriously considering” leaving the company last year before deciding to stay, with some board members favoring Nvidia CFO Colette Kress instead.
[Link: Nvidia board prepares to oust CEO, name interim chief | https://www.semafor.com/article/11/11/2026/nvidia-board-preparing-to-oust-ceo-huang-wsj | Semafor]
